title: Isandro and the Garden
author: S. M. Joubert
blurb: Wendell Thornbury, the youngest member of a dying guild, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
